Kardaur

Biography

Kardaur is the Khadaganian lieutenant who presents the captured Zak to Aiset-Bek. He arranges the prisoner hunt in Death Canyon and threatens punishment even beyond death if Zak fails to entertain his superior. The Odalisque, whom he enslaves, helps Zak escape and points out that Kardaur will be guarding the gate. [1, 2, 3]
